sql: with cur as (select market_ticker, series_ticker, end_date, close_time, market_status, target_size from incentive_programs where superseded_at is null and disappeared_at is null and incentive_type='liquidity' and (end_date is null or end_date > now())) select case when close_time is null then 'null' when close_time < now() then 'past' when close_time < now()+interval '1 day' then 'a<1d' when close_time < now()+interval '3 days' then 'b<3d' when close_time < now()+interval '5 days' then 'c<5d' when close_time < now()+interval '14 days' then 'd<14d' when close_time < now()+interval '60 days' then 'e<60d' else 'f>60d' end bucket, count(*) n, count(distinct series_ticker) series from cur group by 1 union all select 'QUAKE:'||market_ticker, extract(epoch from (close_time-now()))/86400, 0 from incentive_programs where market_ticker like 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' and superseded_at is null order by 1
